# Vendored browser libraries

Served from this site so pages make no third-party requests. Files are unmodified
copies of the published packages; update by replacing them with another pinned release.

| Package | Version | Files | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [MapLibre GL JS](https://maplibre.org/) | 6.11.2 | `maplibre-gl/*.mjs`, `maplibre-gl.css` | npm `maplibre-gl@6.11.2`, `dist/` | BSD-3-Clause (`maplibre-gl/LICENSE.txt`) |
| [PMTiles](https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles) | 4.5.0 | `pmtiles/pmtiles.js` | npm `pmtiles@4.5.0`, `dist/pmtiles.js` | BSD-3-Clause (`pmtiles/LICENSE`) |

Map label fonts in `../map/fonts` are Noto Sans glyph ranges from
[protomaps/basemaps-assets](https://github.com/protomaps/basemaps-assets), under the SIL
Open Font License 1.1 (`../map/fonts/OFL.txt`).
